title: Longest Streak (Sliding Window)

links.title: LeetCode: Longest Substring Without Repeating Characters

hints: Brute force: check every substring for duplicates - O(n^3) naively, O(n^2) with a set. Think about a window [start, i] that you grow to the right and shrink from the left only when needed.
Remember the last index where each character was seen. When s[i] was seen at an index >= start, the window must start right after that occurrence.
Never move start backwards: start = max(start, last[c] + 1). The trap is the input "abba".
Characters are bytes: std::array<int, 256> works as a map from character to its last index. Index it with static_cast<unsigned char>(ch).
